evidence.note: One finding title: 12 and 14 Cross-town fell 14 and 11 points while the network fell 5; number-dense but a single claim.
Grouped Q2/Q3 bars; the 12 and 14 Cross-town Q3 bars (70%, 74%) visibly drop lowest while Other six hold at 87%, pointing the same way as the title.
Two short paragraphs: a chart definition and a restatement that the cross-town routes fell furthest; supports rather than competes.
A 90% target line is added; all bars sit below it, a minor secondary reading but the drop of the two routes stays the dominant visual.
Insight tile restates the same point (routes 12 and 14 account for almost all of the fall) over a blurred chart; no new message.

rationale: Title, chart and insight all carry one message: the two cross-town routes drove the network's fall while the rest held. The layout is sparse (title, one chart, short side text), so a viewer can restate the point after a glance even though the title is number-heavy. The target line adds only a minor secondary cue without competing.
